sentences.text: Adam Douglas Driver -LRB- born November 19 , 1983 -RRB- is an American actor .

He rose to prominence in the supporting role of Adam Sackler in the HBO comedy-drama series Girls -LRB- 2012 -- 2017 -RRB- , for which he received three consecutive nominations for the Primetime Emmy Award for Outstanding Supporting Actor in a Comedy Series .
